observations: Requires independently supplied whole ZIP byte count and SHA-256 matching the manifest.
Validates unique ordered part names, bounds, sums and hashes, then checks reconstructed whole bytes/hash.
Refuses existing final output; uses exclusive/private partial with no-follow descriptor, flock and link without replacement.
Interrupted or corrupt partial bytes remain preserved; resume verifies existing bytes against complete part pins.
No archive extraction or execution, no credentials, no changes to original complete R2 snapshot.
scope: Read-only implementation/documentation spot-check; no helper tests or full public reconstruction rerun by this reviewer. Separate owner qualification and actual anonymous reconstruction remain required.
future_publication_requirement: Published helper must match this hash or a separately reviewed revision.
